signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back.
signIn.failed: We could not sign you in. Check the address and the password, then try again.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: It takes a moment.
register.failed: We could not complete that just now. Please try again.
register.nameRequired: Tell us what to call you.
register.accepted: Thanks. If that address had no account, a message is on its way to it with a link to confirm.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your address
verifyEmail.noLink: Open the link in the message we sent you, or ask for a new one below.
verifyEmail.verified: Your address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verifyEmail.alreadyUsed: That link has already been used. If your address is confirmed, just sign in.
verifyEmail.expired: That link has expired. Ask for a new one below.
verifyEmail.failed: We could not confirm your address just now. Please try again.
verifyEmail.resent: If that address needs confirming, a new message is on its way to it.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will send you a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.asked: If that address has an account, a message is on its way to it.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Pick something you have not used elsewhere.
resetPassword.noLink: Open the link in the message we sent you.
resetPassword.alreadyUsed: That link has already been used. Ask for a new one.
resetPassword.expired: That link has expired. Ask for a new one.
resetPassword.failed: We could not set your password just now. Please try again.
resetPassword.endsEverySession: Setting a new password signs you out everywhere, including any device you left signed in.
resetPassword.done: Your password is set, and every session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

mfa.title: One more step
mfa.subtitle: Confirm it is you.
mfa.failed: We could not verify that. Sign in again to try another way.
mfa.noCodeMethod: Use a recovery code, or a passkey if you have one.

oauthCallback.title: Signing you in
oauthCallback.failed: We could not complete that sign-in just now. Please try again.

errors.AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED: That sign-in attempt took too long and has expired. Please start again.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_UNKNOWN: We could not recognise that sign-in attempt. Please start again.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: We could not reach that sign-in provider just now. Please try again.
errors.EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: That provider has not confirmed the address it gave us. Confirm it with the provider, then try again.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account already exists for that address. Sign in the way you already do, then link this provider from your account settings.
errors.IDENTITY_ALREADY_LINKED: That sign-in is already linked to a different account.
errors.ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE: That account cannot sign in right now.

profile.title: Profile
profile.failed: We could not save that just now. Please try again.
profile.nameRequired: Tell us what to call you.

security.title: Security
security.wrongCurrent: That is not your current password.
security.failed: We could not change your password just now. Please try again.
security.endsOtherSessions: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else. This device stays signed in.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.subtitle: Every session open on your account. End any you do not recognise.
sessions.failed: We could not read your sessions just now. Please try again.

identities.title: Ways to sign in
identities.subtitle: Every way you can prove this account is yours. You must keep at least one.
identities.failed: We could not read this just now. Please try again.
identities.lastRemaining: This is your only way to sign in. Add another before removing it.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Ask for a second proof when you sign in, so a stolen password is not enough.
mfa.empty: You have not set up a second step yet.
mfa.failed: We could not do that just now. Please try again.
mfa.passkeyRestart: That step did not complete and the passkey step has been used up, so nothing was added. Touch your key again and enter a fresh code, or a recovery code you have not used.
mfa.passkeyDismissed: The passkey prompt was closed or timed out, so nothing was added. Try again when you are ready.
mfa.labelMissing: Give it a name, so you can tell it from another.
mfa.addTotpLabel: Name for a new authenticator app
mfa.recoveryLow: Running low: {count} left. Get new recovery codes before you run out.
mfa.recoveryNone: You have no recovery codes left. If you lose access to your authenticator you may be locked out, so get new ones now.

enroll.title: Set up your authenticator app
enroll.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan it? Type this secret into your app instead.
enroll.wrongCode: That code is not right. Check the time on your device and try the next one.

recovery.title: Your recovery codes
recovery.showOnce: These codes will not be shown again. Save them now: nobody, including us, can get them back for you.
recovery.explain: Each code works once, in place of a code from your authenticator, if you lose access to it. Keep them somewhere other than this device.
recovery.copyFailed: We could not copy them. Download them instead.
recovery.saved: I have saved these codes somewhere safe
recovery.leaveWarning: Your recovery codes will not be shown again. Leave without saving them?

proof.title: Confirm it is you
proof.requiredRemove: This is your last second step. Removing it turns two-step verification off, so we need a code from it, or one of your recovery codes, first.
proof.requiredRegenerate: New recovery codes replace the ones you have now, so we need a code from your authenticator, or one of your current recovery codes, first.
proof.requiredEnroll: You already have a second step, so adding another needs a code from it, or one of your recovery codes, first. This stops someone using your open browser from adding a second step of their own.
proof.wrong: That code did not work. Try a fresh code, or a recovery code you have not used.
